issues.description: The SAS source contains no LIBNAME statement or current-directory setup. It reads and writes persistent Data.* tables while controls, sdc_cusip_list, Bloomberg, and data02152021.dta use relative paths. The physical Data library, runtime working directory, and visibility/writability of the input/output locations are unresolved; no external autoexec/include was inspected.

SAS exports data02152021.dta, but the supplied Stata script has no use/import/load statement and therefore assumes its analysis variables are already in memory. A separately configured driver/staging step is required to connect the SAS producer to the Stata consumer; it is not present in this package.

Stata's calendar_qtr token is a unique exact-case prefix of SAS-produced calendar_qtr_end and may resolve under the default varabbrev setting; this is not an established syntax failure. The final DTA is not supplied, so its imported spelling/case and the effective Stata setting remain unverified. Check the staged schema and use the fully expanded existing name or supported setting in the working-copy driver if needed, preserving the same quarter groups; no new producer or formula is indicated by the supplied code.

dependency_review.description: SAS reads the author-prepared Data.comp_2000_2017 panel; its original product origins in Compustat, CRSP, and SEC Analytics are conditional reconstruction context, not independent mandatory AND inputs while that prepared-panel route is selected.

Data.return is produced in SAS from the MSRB, SDC, Bloomberg, and Treasury inputs and is consumed by the final merge; it is not a separate unavailable external table.

review_notes: This scope covers both supplied programs and all source-backed branches in them; the datasheet's wider Powerlytics, RavenPack, IBES, and SIFMA references are contextual because no supplied program consumes them.

The datasheet's BEA, FRED, Pew, and Bloomberg control-source descriptions are historical origins for the controls workbook sheets; they are not separate live raw-data requirements while the supplied SAS code consumes those author-prepared sheets. If raw reconstruction is later chosen, the mappings and transformations require confirmation.
The packaged cusip.dta is a readable identifier list only. No final analysis panel is supplied, so it does not support a separate analysis_only scope or bypass the SAS preparation stage.

The prepared Data.comp_2000_2017 panel remains the primary route. Local COMP.FUNDQ and CRSP.MSF candidates provide only parts of its upstream contract; bounded samples and catalog metadata do not establish complete field mapping, historical-state joins, or coverage.

Catalog misses and the SAS TKELS startup diagnostic do not prove data absence, licensing barriers, or missing entitlement. No additional current-entitlement or author-approval gate is imposed on readable local Compustat/CRSP candidates.
No author program, proposed edit, estimator, or numerical analysis was executed. Runtime and compatibility outcomes remain unverified; execution_verified is false.
